I can help with that — first a quick note about the rebate rules, then I’ll verify your account so I can check eligibility.

Summary of the Platinum Rewards annual-fee rebate (from our policy):
- Rebate amount: $150 if you meet the monthly spend threshold for every month in your cardmember year.
- Monthly threshold: $7,500 in posted net purchases per monthly window.
- You must meet the threshold in all 12 monthly windows of the cardmember year; a single month below the threshold disqualifies the entire year.
- Monthly windows run from your account-opening anniversary day to the day before the next monthly anniversary; only transactions that post within each window count.
- Returns/refunds and disputed transactions can reduce posted totals and affect eligibility.
- If your first-year fee was waived by promotion, rebate eligibility begins the first fee-billed cardmember year.

To check your specific account I’ll need to verify your identity (this is required before I can look up account details). You can choose one of these identifiers for me to look up your record:
- Email address
- Full name (case-sensitive lookup)
- User ID

Once I look up your record I’ll ask you to confirm any two of the following: date of birth, email, phone number, or address. If that’s okay, tell me which identifier you want me to use (email, name, or user ID) and provide it, and I’ll proceed.
You can use my full name for the lookup: **Yuki Nakamura**.
